

This is what the Backend/env/.env should look like:

# Psycopg - Supabase Database Connection Configuration

# Note: The backend is hosted on Render, which currently supports only IPv4
# connections. However, Supabase direct database connections are IPv6-only, 
# which caused connectivity errors. As a result, I went with Supabase Session Pooler
# endpoint instead of the direct database connection because the pooler
# supports IPv4 connections and is compatible with Render.

DB_HOST =
DB_NAME =
DB_USER =
DB_PASSWORD = 
DB_PORT = 


# Supabase API Key:

SUPABASE_URL = 
SUPABASE_KEY =
SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=
